purpose: Cover the four sidecar ledgers, the rcf define ledger CLI (add / resolve / list with --json) and the walker-invisibility invariant on rcf/define/ (AC-17301-1..4 on US-17301), the update subverb and the closed resolvedBy pointer grammar (AC-17302-1..6 on US-17302), the statement-file markers (AC-18701-1..6 on US-18701) and the scan wiring (AC-18702-1..6 on US-18702).
title: Sidecar ledgers, rcf define ledger and walker invisibility (extended for update + intake markers + scans)

testCases.description: rcf define ledger brief add --text mints id 1 with status open, kind capability by default, and writes rcf/define/brief-ledger.json.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI: brief add --text appends a numbered statement

testCases.description: rcf define ledger brief add refuses conflicting --text and --from with a usage-class error (exit 2).
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI: brief add refuses conflicting --text and --from with a usage error

testCases.description: rcf define ledger decisions list prints the numbered #241 format: question, options as 'letter) text', default and blocks labelled on their own lines.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI: decisions list prints the numbered #241 format

testCases.description: rcf define ledger <name> list --json emits { ledger, <arrayKey>: [...] } with the same body loadLedger returns.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI: list --json emits the machine-readable envelope

testCases.description: rcf define ledger brief add --from <file> splits by non-empty lines, mints sequential ids and writes every statement with the resolved kind.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI: brief add --from <file> splits by non-empty line

testCases.description: parseBriefFromFile strips leading '- ', '* ' and '<n>. ' bullets so drafts match the raw statement text.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/ledgers.test.js::ledgers: parseBriefFromFile splits by non-empty lines and strips bullets

testCases.description: walkTree run over a project seeded with rcf/define/freeze.json, the four ledger files and a bug-bait req-999.json under rcf/define/ never surfaces any rcf/define/ path in errors or byId.
testCases.testPointer: test/store/walker-invisible-define.test.js::walkTree never surfaces rcf/define/ files as documents in byId

testCases.description: updateEntry patches brief fields (kind, resolvedBy) and preserves id and addedAt; the CLI brief update subverb returns 0 and the write lands on the ledger with the patched fields.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/ledgers.test.js::updateEntry (AC-17302-1): patches brief fields and preserves id / addedAt

testCases.description: decisions update patches options and default so decisions:wellFormed shape passes (two options + a default).
testCases.testPointer: test/define/ledgers.test.js::updateEntry (AC-17302-2): decisions update patches options and default and passes wellFormed shape

testCases.description: Each resolvedBy pointer form (REQ-nnn, TAD.entity:<name>, PRD.user:<name>, TAD.system:<name>, TAC-nnnn, omitted:<reason>) resolves on the fixture and D2's skeleton:resolvedBy passes it.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (REQ-173, AC-17302-3): each pointer form resolves on the fixture

testCases.description: brief update --resolved-by with a free-text pointer exits 2 naming the grammar and the ledger is unchanged.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI (AC-17302-4): brief update --resolved-by outside the grammar exits 2 and writes nothing

testCases.description: A statement with resolvedBy REQ-999 on a tree with no REQ-999 fails skeleton:resolvedBy with 'pointer does not resolve'.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (REQ-173, AC-17302-5): REQ-999 fails with "pointer does not resolve"

testCases.description: In 0.30.0 skeleton:resolvedBy no longer passes a statement on a REQ-title text hit alone; a resolvedBy pointer is required.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates (REQ-173, AC-17302-6): a text-title hit alone does NOT pass in 0.30.0

testCases.description: parseBriefFromFile parses a leading [kind] and a trailing (source: ...) marker; the CLI brief add --from mints a statement with that kind, text and source.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/ledgers.test.js::parseBriefFromFile (AC-18701-1): leading [kind] and trailing (source: ...) markers mint one statement

testCases.description: A line without markers inherits --kind and --source from CLI flags.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/ledgers.test.js::parseBriefFromFile (AC-18701-2): a line without markers inherits --kind and --source

testCases.description: A trailing '?' or a TBC/TBD/Open:/Question: prefix with no [kind] marker kinds the statement openQuestion.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/ledgers.test.js::parseBriefFromFile (AC-18701-3): a question-mark trailing line is kinded openQuestion

testCases.description: A 0.29.0 line-per-statement file (no markers) parses to the same drafts as the 0.29.0 code path produced.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/ledgers.test.js::parseBriefFromFile (AC-18701-4): a 0.29.0 line-per-statement file parses unchanged

testCases.description: A line with an unknown [kind] exits 2 naming the accepted kinds and writes nothing to the ledger.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI (AC-18701-5): brief add --from with an unknown [kind] exits 2 before writing

testCases.description: brief add --from --dry-run never creates or modifies rcf/define/brief-ledger.json.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI (AC-18701-6, --dry-run): writes nothing

testCases.description: A new statement that the contradiction scan flags against an existing statement adds one openQuestion statement with source scan:contradiction:<id>,<id>.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI (AC-18702-1): mechanical scan on brief add mints an openQuestion with scan: source

testCases.description: --findings <path> accepts rcf discover intake --input shape and mints one openQuestion per finding with source scan:<name>.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI (AC-18702-2): --findings file mints one openQuestion per finding with scan: source

testCases.description: runIntakeScansOnDelta compares every new statement against every existing statement (the frozen set is every statement).
testCases.testPointer: test/intake/validate.test.js::runIntakeScansOnDelta (AC-18702-3): on a frozen set the comparison set is every existing statement

testCases.description: brief add --json emits { added: [...], findings: [...] } on stdout.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI (AC-18702-4, --json): emits { added, findings }

testCases.description: --no-scan combined with --findings exits 2 naming the conflict.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI (AC-18702-5): --no-scan with --findings exits 2

testCases.description: brief add --text runs no scan and appends no openQuestion statement.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/ledger.test.js::ledger CLI (AC-18702-6): --text runs no scan and appends no openQuestion
